purpose: Teach: 月収/出来高/同上/組合せ/既定/特約/あっせん/引き渡し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員の月収を引き上げる決断をされたぞ
lines.en: When you founded the company, you made the decision to raise the monthly wages of your staff.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial. The cadence of someone sharing a remembered principle. Quiet conviction. A slight pause before naming the decision, as if honoring its weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは出来高制の透明性を重んじられました
lines.en: Yes. My father valued the clarity and fairness of performance-based pay.
lines.style: Respectful, grounded. Speaking of principle rather than memory. Steady pace. The voice of someone confirming something foundational, not explaining it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、書類で同上を安易に使わないと仰ってたぞ
lines.en: Your father used to say — never take shortcuts with paperwork by writing 'ditto' just because it's easier.
lines.style: Gentle reproach wrapped in nostalgia. Slight lift of emphasis on 'never.' The tone of someone who remembers being told this and understood why it mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の組合せ提案を社員に求められた
lines.en: Yes. My father would ask the staff themselves to propose new combinations of products.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost quiet. The word 'ask' lands gently — he wasn't commanding, he was inviting. Slow enough to let the significance settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、既定の枠を超えた新事業に挑まれたぞ
lines.en: Your father took on entirely new ventures that went beyond what the company usually did.
lines.style: A note of quiet admiration beneath the surface. The pace slows slightly on 'entirely new' — acknowledging the risk and boldness of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお取引先との特約契約を大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. My father held his partnerships and contracts with our clients as sacred trusts.
lines.style: Firm but not hard. 'Sacred trusts' is the weight here — not rushed, not overstated. The voice of someone inheriting a standard, not just a memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、人材あっせん会社との関係も築かれたぞ
lines.en: Your father built real relationships with the personnel recruitment firms too.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. A slight nod in the voice — recognizing that this wasn't just business, it was relationship. Conversational but grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品引き渡し時、ご自身で確認された
lines.en: Yes. My father always checked the products himself when they were handed over to clients.
lines.style: Quiet pride. The emphasis rests on 'himself' — a man who didn't delegate his standards. Ends with calm finality, like closing a ledger of principles.
